import json, urllib.request, time

API="https://unitreex-test.vercel.app"
ADDR="0xA8b76659d20CeD2eEDa27eFAD194aC757b238Ec7"

def get_free_ch():
    with urllib.request.urlopen(f"{API}/api/challenge?address={ADDR}&free=1") as r:
        return json.load(r)

def solve(wrap, plan):
    ch=wrap["challenge"]
    body={
      "challenge": {
        "address": ch["address"],
        "nonce": ch["nonce"],
        "missionId": ch["missionId"],
        "issuedAt": ch["issuedAt"],
        "owned": ch["owned"],
        "totalMinted": ch["totalMinted"],
        "mintPrice": ch["mintPrice"],
        "passScore": ch["passScore"],
        "notBefore": ch["notBefore"],
        "hard": ch["hard"],
        "sig": ch["sig"],
        "shareChallenge": ch.get("shareChallenge") or "",
        "lane": ch.get("lane") or "paid",
        "epoch": int(ch.get("epoch") or 0),
      },
      "answer": json.dumps(plan),
      "quantity": 1,
      "priority": False,
      "free": True,
    }
    req=urllib.request.Request(f"{API}/api/solve", data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={"content-type":"application/json"}, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
            return json.load(r)
    except Exception as e:
        raw=e.read().decode() if hasattr(e,'read') else str(e)
        return {"error": raw, "code": getattr(e,'code',None)}

plans = [
("via-bin-finer", {"plan":[
  {"op":"wait","cond":"temp_below"},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[5.5,12.0]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[8.8,9.6]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[11.6,7.6]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[13.56,6.33]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[15.3,4.1]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":"t01"},
  {"op":"cut","target":"t01","offset_mm":3,"force_n":6.3},
  {"op":"transport","to":"bin"},
]}),
("via-bin-offset-north", {"plan":[
  {"op":"wait","cond":"temp_below"},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[6.5,12.2]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[10.2,9.1]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[13.2,6.9]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[15.0,4.6]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":"t01"},
  {"op":"cut","target":"t01","offset_mm":3,"force_n":6.3},
  {"op":"transport","to":"bin"},
]}),
("via-bin-offset-south", {"plan":[
  {"op":"wait","cond":"temp_below"},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[5.2,10.8]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[9.4,7.8]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[13.0,5.7]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":[15.4,3.6]},
  {"op":"navigate","to":"t01"},
  {"op":"cut","target":"t01","offset_mm":3,"force_n":6.3},
  {"op":"transport","to":"bin"},
]}),
]

for i,(name, plan) in enumerate(plans):
    wrap=get_free_ch()
    res=solve(wrap, plan)
    detail=res.get("detail") or {}
    row={
      "name": name,
      "score": res.get("scoreExact") or res.get("score"),
      "align": detail.get("align"),
      "eff": detail.get("eff"),
      "leading": res.get("leading"),
      "leader": res.get("leader"),
      "error": res.get("error"),
      "entries": res.get("entries"),
    }
    print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    if i < len(plans)-1:
        time.sleep(1)
print("DONE")
